correction_1_battery_throughput_audit.forensic_correction_note: The raw 49-column telemetry schema records cumulative_battery_throughput_after strictly for Arm 3 (V3 Class F). It does not record arm-specific cumulative battery throughput for Arm 2 (V2 Treatment) or Arm 1 (Control). Equality cannot be inferred from the raw CSV.

stage81_forecast_shape_verification.mechanism_interaction: At h=14..16, Stage 8.1 over-predicts solar irradiance by +19.72 W/m^2. Under gamma=1.0, full penalty weight (w_13=1.0) leads optimizer to expect late solar energy and plan late battery charging. Under gamma=0.95, penalty weights at h=14..16 are discounted by over 50% (w_13=0.5133), suppressing optimizer over-reaction to late-horizon solar over-prediction.

candidate_v4_hypotheses.name: Term-Specific Horizon Discounting (gamma_curtail vs gamma_diesel)
candidate_v4_hypotheses.target_mechanism: Decouple discount factor applied to solar curtailment penalties from immediate diesel fuel costs.
candidate_v4_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Class F objective decomposition proves curtailment penalty discount at h=14..16 reduces pre-emptive diesel dispatch.
candidate_v4_hypotheses.missing_evidence: Whether keeping gamma_diesel = 1.0 while setting gamma_curtail = 0.90 achieves equal fuel reduction without increasing late diesel risk.

candidate_v4_hypotheses.name: Forecast-Uncertainty-Adaptive SOC Reserve Policy
candidate_v4_hypotheses.target_mechanism: Dynamically adjust minimum SOC reserve bounds E_min(t) based on rolling forecast variance f_var(y_pred).
candidate_v4_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Observed early SOC divergence at t=0..1 shows battery positioning absorbs forecast error prior to diesel start.
candidate_v4_hypotheses.missing_evidence: Whether dynamic SOC reserve bounds outperform uniform horizon discounting under high forecast variance.

candidate_v4_hypotheses.name: Minimum-Runtime Diesel Commitment Hysteresis
candidate_v4_hypotheses.target_mechanism: Enforce explicit minimum runtime constraints T_min,on for diesel generator commitment.
candidate_v4_hypotheses.supporting_evidence: V3 Class F reduced generator startups from 1.03 to 0.76; explicit hysteresis targets remaining short runs.
candidate_v4_hypotheses.missing_evidence: Interaction between minimum runtime constraints and receding horizon MPC replays.
